mapper.select: /* selectLatestImport */ SELECT import_id ,user_id ,source_filename ,wizard_id ,wizard_name ,server_id ,unit_count ,rune_count ,crt_date as uploaded_at FROM swex_account_import WHERE user_id = #{sess_user_id} ORDER BY import_id DESC LIMIT 1

/* selectImportList */ SELECT import_id ,source_filename ,wizard_id ,wizard_name ,server_id ,unit_count ,rune_count ,crt_date as uploaded_at FROM swex_account_import WHERE user_id = #{sess_user_id} ORDER BY import_id DESC LIMIT 50

/* selectImportDetail */ SELECT import_id ,user_id ,source_filename ,wizard_id ,wizard_name ,server_id ,unit_count ,rune_count ,crt_date as uploaded_at FROM swex_account_import WHERE user_id = #{sess_user_id} AND import_id = CAST(#{import_id} AS BIGINT)

/* selectMonsterList */ SELECT sm.unit_id ,sm.master_id ,m.kr_name ,m.un_name ,sm.level ,sm.stars ,sm.attribute ,sm.awaken_level ,sm.is_awakened FROM swex_monster sm JOIN swex_account_import si ON si.import_id = sm.import_id AND si.user_id = #{sess_user_id} LEFT JOIN public.monster m ON m.com2us_id = sm.master_id WHERE sm.import_id = CAST(#{import_id} AS BIGINT) ORDER BY sm.unit_id DESC LIMIT CAST(#{limit} AS INTEGER) OFFSET CAST(#{offset} AS INTEGER)

/* selectMonsterListCount */ SELECT COUNT(*) FROM swex_monster sm JOIN swex_account_import si ON si.import_id = sm.import_id AND si.user_id = #{sess_user_id} WHERE sm.import_id = CAST(#{import_id} AS BIGINT)

/* selectMonsterCatalog */ WITH owned AS ( -- 보유 몬스터는 (노각성/각성)을 각성 버전(com2us_id)으로 매핑해서 합산 카운트 SELECT COALESCE(m.awakens_to_id, m.com2us_id) AS awakened_com2us_id ,COUNT(*) AS owned_count FROM swex_monster sm JOIN swex_account_import si ON si.import_id = sm.import_id AND si.user_id = #{sess_user_id} JOIN public.monster m ON m.com2us_id = sm.master_id WHERE sm.import_id = CAST(#{import_id} AS BIGINT) GROUP BY COALESCE(m.awakens_to_id, m.com2us_id) ) SELECT m.monster_id ,m.com2us_id ,m.monster_elemental ,m.kr_name ,m.un_name ,m.image_url ,COALESCE(o.owned_count, 0) AS owned_count FROM public.monster m LEFT JOIN owned o ON o.awakened_com2us_id = m.com2us_id WHERE 1=1 -- 각성 버전만 노출 (노각성은 제외) AND m.awakens_to_id IS NULL -- 사용(획득) 가능한 몬스터만 노출 (usg_yn 개념) AND COALESCE(m.obtainable, true) = true
AND LOWER(m.monster_elemental) = LOWER(#{monster_elemental})
AND ( LOWER(m.kr_name) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR LOWER(m.un_name) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR CAST(m.com2us_id AS TEXT) LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' )
-- 정렬: 2각(awaken_level=2) 우선 → 별(자연별/기본별/별) → com2us_id ORDER BY CASE WHEN COALESCE(m.awaken_level, 0) >= 2 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC, COALESCE(m.natural_stars, m.base_stars, m.star) DESC NULLS LAST, COALESCE(m.base_stars, m.star) DESC NULLS LAST, m.star DESC, m.com2us_id ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT CAST(#{limit} AS INTEGER) OFFSET CAST(#{offset} AS INTEGER)

/* selectRuneList */ SELECT r.rune_id ,r.unit_id ,r.slot ,r.set_id ,r.grade ,r.level ,r.rank ,r.main_stat_type ,r.main_stat_value ,r.substats_json FROM swex_rune r JOIN swex_account_import si ON si.import_id = r.import_id AND si.user_id = #{sess_user_id} WHERE r.import_id = CAST(#{import_id} AS BIGINT) ORDER BY r.rune_id DESC LIMIT CAST(#{limit} AS INTEGER) OFFSET CAST(#{offset} AS INTEGER)
/* selectRuneListCount */ SELECT COUNT(*) FROM swex_rune r JOIN swex_account_import si ON si.import_id = r.import_id AND si.user_id = #{sess_user_id} WHERE r.import_id = CAST(#{import_id} AS BIGINT)

/* selectRunesForScoreSummary */ SELECT r.rune_id ,r.set_id ,r.occupied_type ,r.occupied_id ,r.unit_id ,r.substats_json ,r.prefix_eff_json FROM swex_rune r JOIN swex_account_import si ON si.import_id = r.import_id AND si.user_id = #{sess_user_id} WHERE r.import_id = CAST(#{import_id} AS BIGINT)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.user_monster_owned_agg ( wizard_id, master_id, copy_count, source_import_id, source_import_at, computed_at ) WITH latest_import AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (si.wizard_id) si.wizard_id, si.import_id, si.crt_date FROM swex_account_import si WHERE si.wizard_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY si.wizard_id, si.import_id DESC ) SELECT TRIM(BOTH FROM li.wizard_id::text), sm.master_id, COUNT(*)::int, li.import_id, li.crt_date, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM latest_import li INNER JOIN swex_monster sm ON sm.import_id = li.import_id WHERE sm.master_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY li.wizard_id, li.import_id, li.crt_date, sm.master_id
